text:
lena: FYI I found a spike in per-org ratelimit rejections after yesterday's routing tweak. Looks like requests routed via tenant-sticky proxy are getting counted against both the org and the temporary session token.
ophelia: can you paste an example request id?
lena: req: `r-8f9c2` header dump: `X-Token-Type: session`, `X-Session-Owner: org:acme`, `X-Routed-Via: sticky-proxy-3` and the quota logs show meter labels `{owner:org:acme, token:session-123}` AND `{owner:session-123, token:session-123}`.
matt_b: ah, the meter labels are being generated by two layers: authn layer creates owner=token subject, then routing layer augments owner=origin-org. Both are getting recorded.
ravi: quick thoughts: we need a canonicalization step where quota labels are normalized to a single owner field and we tag the lineage differently (e.g., owner=canonical_owner, lineage=[origin,route]). That way counts go to canonical_owner but we still preserve fallback path for debugging/alerts.
ophelia: agree. Proposal: add `quota_owner` header set after resolution (authn+routing) and change meter library to prefer `quota_owner` if present. Also emit `quota_lineage` as a high-cardinality tag only to debug sink (not billing).
console-bot: note: console has a panel `quota.rate.by_owner` that assumes owner label equals billing entity. Changing labels could break historical panels.
lena: plan: 1) config flag `quota_canonicalization_v2` in auth chain, default off. 2) auth-service sets `X-Quota-Owner` after routing resolution. 3) meter library reads `X-Quota-Owner` -> uses that as primary owner, preserves `X-Quota-Lineage` to debug index only. 4) console team adds temporary migration layer to map old owner label to new `quota_owner` in dashboards.
matt_b: rollout mechanics: flip flag in staging, run 24h load test with synthetic tenants, then progressive canary to dedicated clusters (us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1).
ravi: metric/alert surface: add `quota.owner_mismatch` counter when both old-owner label and quota_owner differ for same request. Add a Grafana panel showing mismatch rate; trigger page if >1% sustained for 30m during rollout.
console-bot: owners @ophelia and @lena will need to update the quota table view to include an optional column "billing_owner" which maps canonical owner -> billing account. Also add a toggle to show lineage for triage.
ophelia: UX note: avoid showing high-cardinality lineage by default. It should be collapsed behind a "show raw attribution" link.
audit-bot: audit-log: created ticket PLAT-2199 "Canonical quota owner header + dashboard migration".
lena: tests to add in PRs:
```
- request with scoped session token that routes to different project -> assert only `quota_owner` is billed
- request without `X-Quota-Owner` -> fall back to legacy behavior
- mismatch case increments `quota.owner_mismatch`
- console migration preserves historical panels for 90d
```
matt_b: I'll send two PRs: auth-service (emit header + flag) and meter-lib (prefer header + emit mismatch metric). Add feature flag gating in both.
ravi: once canary looks good, we should run a billing-simulator against a recent day to validate no cost drift. Also coordinate with finance to watch actual invoices next cycle.
ophelia: sounds good. tagging @console-team for dashboard changes. I'll coordinate a small runbook for oncall if mismatch alert fires.
lena: thanks all, will attach sample traces and the failing query to PLAT-2199. Ping when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
